name: Translate and refine multilingual text
description: Users asked to translate texts between various languages, with a primary focus on Chinese to English, and then refine, polish, or proofread the translated or original content for better style, grammar, and clarity. Some requests involved evaluating existing translations or rewriting text within the same language for improved flow and professionalism.
